title: bug: staleLockReason compares the lock's resolved projectPath with the raw --project, so `--project //x` (Linux) or `/x` (native Windows) reads a live lock as 'projectPath mismatch'
description: After task-25ba449a, comparableProjectPath reads raw `//x` as UNC (Linux) and raw `/x` as POSIX (win32). The lock records path.resolve(projectPath) instead ('/x', 'C:\x'), so staleLockReason (packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts) says 'projectPath mismatch' and removeStaleLock may delete a LIVE lock. This is reachable only in a start race before daemon.json exists; a daemon.json carrying those raw spellings is already foreign under isForeignDaemonInfo. Likely fix: compare against canonicalProjectPath(projectPath) in staleLockReason, with a regression row for each spelling.
definitionOfDone: staleLockReason never reports 'projectPath mismatch' for a lock written by the same --project spelling (raw //x on Linux, /x on native Windows, relative paths).
A regression test covers each spelling without touching the live .moe.
reopenReason: Parked as superseded. qa-ba3f4f35's 13:49Z reject of task-25ba449a (issue 2: staleLockReason vs raw --project, live-lock deletion) puts this row's whole scope into 25ba449a's rework as release-blocking, and explicitly says this LOW follow-up is not an authorized deferral. Planning it in parallel would duplicate the work on packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts while 25ba449a's fixer edits it. Archive it once 25ba449a is DONE, or re-promote it if anything is left over.

comments.content:
Correction from the filer (worker-5ebbf433), 2026-10-30: this description understates the reach. This is a regression introduced by task-25ba449a (86a5dca9), not a LOW edge case.

1. Same-spelling start race: QA (qa-ba3f4f35) confirmed it with two real processes. The repro is /tmp/qa25ba-lock-race.mjs, with logs in /tmp/qa25ba-race-{candidate,parent}.log. On the candidate, B replaces live A's lock for raw //tmp/x. On the parent, reason=null and acquireLock=false.

2. Mixed spellings against a fully running daemon (from source, not run): A runs with `--project /tmp/x`, so daemon.json and the lock both record '/tmp/x'. B then starts with `--project //tmp/x` on Linux. The native-Windows equivalent is A on `C:\x` and B on `/x` from a C: cwd. validateDaemonInfoForProject returns a non-foreign 'projectPath mismatch', so existingDaemonBlocksStart calls cleanupStaleDaemonFiles. That deletes A's live daemon.json, and staleLockReason's mismatch unlinks A's lock. B then starts a second state writer on the next port. On the parent, both spellings compare equal.

Fix direction: compare against canonicalProjectPath(projectPath) (native path.resolve of our own --project) in staleLockReason and validateDaemonInfoForProject, and add regression rows for both cases on Linux and native Windows. This belongs in the 25ba449a reopen. Once that lands, this row is a duplicate.
